section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the measurement of life satisfaction using the Satisfaction with Life Scale (SLS), a 5-item instrument rated on a 5-point scale. The section reports that the Malay version of the SLS demonstrated adequate internal consistency and good construct validity, with an omega coefficient of .83 (95% CI = .81-.85) in the present work. This is a methods subsection focused on measurement instruments, not on study design or participant demographics.
